## What's new

### Native bars with the system Liquid Glass animations
- **Tab bar:** now the iOS system tab bar, with Home, Library and Settings. **Search** is the round button at the bottom right, and it expands into the search field with the native iOS 26 animation, like the Photos app. **L1 / R1** switch tabs with a controller, and **△** opens Search and focuses the field.
- **PC button:** now a system navigation bar item. The PC menu opens with the native Liquid Glass morph. With a controller connected it shows **□**, and □ opens the navigable PC panel, because system menus can't be driven with a controller.
- **Status:** clock, controller, network and battery now sit in the navigation bar on every tab, drawn by the system as Liquid Glass.

The hand-made top bar, search capsule and tab bar were removed.

### Known limits of the system components
- The system tab bar can't show the L1/R1 glyphs, and the system search button can't show the "Search game" text or the △ glyph.

## Install
Download `Starlight.ipa` below and install it with [Sideloadly](https://sideloadly.io) over your current version, using the same Bundle ID.
